title: Side-quest: agent-do dictate — Wispr-class streaming dictation (grab-safe, off the moon graph)
description: tools/agent-dictate/ with a small Swift helper adapted from telefollower (~400 proven lines): AudioCaptureEngine (shared-mic AVAudioEngine, VAD, 16kHz PCM16), DeepgramStreamingClient (Nova-3 WebSocket, interim/final, utterance-end, keepalive), GlobalHotkeyManager (Carbon, extend to press/release hold-to-talk). Streaming primary via DEEPGRAM_API_KEY in creds; fallback agent-transcribe --method local-whisper; optional AI-helper cleanup pass. Insertion via live-gated macos substrate, never clipboard-clobber. One-shot mode for agents, hold-to-talk resident mode for humans. The +++: keyterm prompting primed from working context (coord focus paths, manna titles, branch names) so technical vocabulary transcribes correctly. House pattern: registry+contracts+tests+docs. No deps on moon trunks A-G. CROSS-REPO CONTEXT (2026-07-17): this is the SENSES layer of the Second Chair split designed in holy-ghostty (tracker mn-6e363f there, Codex red-team pending): agent-do owns abilities (dictate, say/TTS, chair engine), Holy Ghostty owns embodiment (panel, focus-follow, draft insertion, process supervision). Dictate stays consumable standalone; Holy is one consumer, not a dependency.

title: Harness upgrade: execute Codex's revised six-commit plan (models/zpc/browse/git/discovery)
description: Plan: .handoff/2026-07-16-harness-upgrade-plan.md as CORRECTED by Codex review (verified claim-by-claim 2026-07-17, all true). Six commits: 1) fix(models) centralize internal model defaults — scope is agent-do-owned internal generation defaults ONLY, never generated templates or user provider engines; per-model capability records, inaccessible != retired. 2) feat(models) capability-aware OpenAI fallback. 3) fix(zpc) global lessons in read surfaces; tests isolate AGENT_DO_HOME. 4) feat(browse) session-safe daemon diagnosis/self-heal — REMOVE broad pkill at agent-browse:1704, verify PID identity before every signal (borrow coord v2 pid+start-time anchoring), ping in protocol.js that never auto-launches, two-daemon isolation test mandatory. 5) feat(git) guarded worktree/recovery — commit REFUSES when nothing staged (kill git add -A at agent-git:167), staged-diff-only secret scan with redacted output, recover without --lost-found (it writes), sweep excludes worktrees/protected/unpushed with --apply. 6) fix(discovery) factory index generated from registry.yaml + repo-owned override file (migrate the hand-added coord entry); ~/.factory is installed cache; fix suggest credential bypass at agent-do:311. Each commit: targeted tests + contracts validate + ./test.sh. Executor: the standing Codex session.

title: [P1][SECURITY][VOICE] voice speak: replace eval'd shell-string with argument arrays
description: Found during Second Chair review 2026-07-17 (verified: tools/agent-voice ~line 63-66 builds cmd string and evals it). Any spoken text containing $(...), backticks, or quotes can execute commands — and the Second Chair plan routes MODEL OUTPUT through this tool, making it a direct injection→execution path. Fix: exec say/espeak with argument arrays, never eval; adversarial tests (command substitution, quotes, newlines, ANSI); same audit for the Linux branches. Blocks Second Chair C4 (holy-ghostty board mn-a40d06).
